lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in repeating vertical columns along the lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal ridges (carinae) to form a grid where high-intensity blobs are centered at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features running parallel along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant semi-circular indentation or tissue deficit on the posterior-superior margin of the first dorsal fin.
